# Sprint 4 model cards (generated by `python -m src.league_models.ml_benchmark`)

All models: gradient-boosted trees on the score-only feature contract (`s4_feature_schema.json`, hash `0e5a2f89ec06b3d9`), odds-free, fitted per outer fold on matches available at the fold cutoff, parameters frozen for the eval season, `BACKTEST_LIMITED`, DEV-only evidence, raw (uncalibrated) probabilities. None is in production.

**Odds-aware model card: NOT_AVAILABLE.** The licensed universe has no timestamped odds, so no odds-aware model and no market baseline were built and no claim about beating the market is made. **xG, lineups, injuries, shots: not in the universe, never imputed.**

## A_gbm
Frozen global GBM baseline: league-blind features (no league identity, no league priors), fixed parameters, fixed rounds.

- Parameters: LightGBM, 150 rounds, defaults {"bagging_fraction": 0.8, "bagging_freq": 1, "cat_smooth": 20.0, "feature_fraction": 0.8, "lambda_l1": 0.0, "lambda_l2": 5.0, "learning_rate": 0.05, "max_depth": -1, "min_data_in_leaf": 50, "min_data_per_group": 50, "num_leaves": 8}; the production XGBoost/LightGBM cannot run here, so this is a score-only re-implementation.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: TRAINED | 2021-22: TRAINED | 2022-23: TRAINED | 2023-24: TRAINED | 2024-25: TRAINED
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals carry a home advantage; clubs new to the history get NaN form and are flagged; permutation importance is an association on the inner-validation season, never a cause.

## A_gbm_tuned
Control: the league-blind features of A_gbm, tuned like B.

- Parameters: Same tuner, grid, trials and rounds rule as B_gbm_league; separates the effect of league awareness from the effect of tuning.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: see run records | 2021-22: see run records | 2022-23: see run records | 2023-24: see run records | 2024-25: see run records
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals carry a home advantage; clubs new to the history get NaN form and are flagged; permutation importance is an association on the inner-validation season, never a cause.

## B_gbm_league_default
Global GBM with league identity (categorical) and league-season priors, fixed parameters.

- Parameters: Same as A_gbm plus league_identity and league_priors: isolates the league effect.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: TRAINED | 2021-22: TRAINED | 2022-23: TRAINED | 2023-24: TRAINED | 2024-25: TRAINED
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals carry a home advantage; clubs new to the history get NaN form and are flagged; permutation importance is an association on the inner-validation season, never a cause.

## B_gbm_league
Same features as B default; parameters tuned by Optuna on the inner-validation season only.

- Parameters: TPE, 14 trials per fold and target on a coarse grid, early stopping 30; final rounds = best iteration scaled by training / inner-fit size.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: TRAINED | 2021-22: TRAINED | 2022-23: TRAINED | 2023-24: TRAINED | 2024-25: TRAINED
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals carry a home advantage; clubs new to the history get NaN form and are flagged; permutation importance is an association on the inner-validation season, never a cause.

## B_xgb_league
XGBoost with the B features and fixed parameters (backend cross-check, not tuned).

- Parameters: {"colsample_bytree": 0.8, "learning_rate": 0.05, "max_depth": 3, "min_child_weight": 10.0, "reg_alpha": 0.0, "reg_lambda": 5.0, "rounds": 150, "subsample": 0.8}
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: TRAINED | 2021-22: TRAINED | 2022-23: TRAINED | 2023-24: TRAINED | 2024-25: TRAINED
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals carry a home advantage; clubs new to the history get NaN form and are flagged; permutation importance is an association on the inner-validation season, never a cause.

## C_gbm_local
One GBM per competition on its own history.

- Parameters: LOCAL_INELIGIBLE under 500 matches or with a class under 10 examples (explicit fallback to B); capacity capped at 8 leaves; matches between 500 and 1500 are evidence only, out-of-sample proof required.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: see run records | 2021-22: see run records | 2022-23: see run records | 2023-24: see run records | 2024-25: see run records
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals carry a home advantage; clubs new to the history get NaN form and are flagged; permutation importance is an association on the inner-validation season, never a cause.

## D_gbm_blend
(1 - w) * B + w * C per competition and target (probability level, simplex preserved).

- Parameters: w from inner-validation predictions, grid 0.05, must beat B by 0.002 log loss, shrunk by n/(n+300); 0 otherwise.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: see run records | 2021-22: see run records | 2022-23: see run records | 2023-24: see run records | 2024-25: see run records
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals carry a home advantage; clubs new to the history get NaN form and are flagged; permutation importance is an association on the inner-validation season, never a cause.
